dataList.content:
Yuri’s head stood motionless, facing Gregor. Her face was upright.
尤莉的面容一动不动地注视着格里高尔，就这么保持着笔直的姿势。
dataList.place:
District 4 - LC Branch Interior
4区 脑叶公司支部内某处

dataList.content:
However, the Yuri we knew, the Yuri who accompanied us, was always hunched over.
但是，我们所认识的那个尤莉，总是弯着腰。

Slouched and laden as though it were the obligation of the sole survivor to carry the weight of her dead colleagues.
她背负着已故同事们沉重的遗愿，仿佛是作为唯一幸存者的职责一般。

So, I had no reason to hesitate to warn him.
因此，我才能有把握地告诉他。

<That's not Yuri, Gregor.>
<那不是尤莉，格里高尔。>

... No. I don't think it is, either.
……没错。我也那么想。

Gregor accepts it calmly.
格里高尔淡然地肯定道。

He then outstretches his arm, sending it flying toward "Yuri."
然后格里高尔的手臂开始伸长，并快速向尤莉突进。

Yet, it soon pauses mid-air.
不过，其很快就停了下来。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
I didn’t want to die.
我不想死。

<Cut her down, Gregor.>
<斩下去，格里高尔。>

I don’t know if this is the right thing to do as the manager,
我不知道这是否是作为一个经理的正确做法。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
None of us wanted to die.
我们没有人想死。

but I had to shout at Gregor now to stop him from breaking.
但如今我必须冲着格里高尔大喊，以免他的身心就此毁坏。

<Cut it now!>
<斩下去！>

Gah, aaaaargh!!!
呃、呃啊啊！！！

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
I-I don’t wanna die!
我、我不想死啊！

This... This is...
这、这是……

The verminous arm stopped inches away from piercing the civilian’s throat.
虫一般的手臂在刺穿那个平民的喉咙之前停了下来。

I pulled against it with all my might, but it wouldn’t budge.
我竭尽全力想要拉住它，但它纹丝不动。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
P-please, please don't kill me... Just take my money, whatever you want—!
请、请放过我吧……我把我所有的钱都给你。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
Let the woman go! Otherwise, I will stop you by force!
放那位女士离开！否则我将进行应对攻击！

My arm... Cut off the arm! Now!
我的手臂……帮我把手臂砍下来！马上！

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
This is your final warning. Release her now, or...
我再说一遍。如果不释放……

Cut it off!
快砍啊！

As the dismembered arm falls to the ground, she slides down the wall, gasping.
被砍掉的手臂落到地上之后，那位女士喘息着，倚墙滑坐下来。

However, peace doesn’t last long—the arm starts regenerating from its twitching stump.
但伴随着痉挛，手臂从被切下的部位开始了再生。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
Are you alright, sir?
您没事吧？

No, stay away from me! Don’t come any closer!
别、别靠近！不要靠近我！

The regrown arm rushes forward as if it remembered the pain it suffered mere moments ago.
仿佛仍记得刚刚所受的痛苦一般，再生出的手臂再次快速向前冲去。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
You have my utmost respect, Manager Gregor, sir!
格里高尔科长，向您致以最高的敬意！

Don't... don't do that... I never even wanted to be a part of this war...
不要尊敬我……我不是自愿参战的……

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
What was I supposed to do? Is it so wrong that I survived?
那到底要我怎么办？难道幸存下来是一种罪孽吗？

Please, live... just live on... None of us asked for this to happen, none of us asked to be in this mess...
活下去，求你了……我们明明都不是自愿落入这场悲剧的吧。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
To be so close, here, on the very periphery of the end... only to be stopped moments before your labor bears fruit. How regrettable.
最后的最后，你却在结出的果实面前停下来了。多么遗憾啊。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Well, we’ll take it. Opportunities left unclaimed will only become null and void.
不过，我们会接手的。你们没有抓住的机会，只会白白溜走。

Yuri’s head tumbled to the ground.
尤莉的头颅滚落在地。

It wasn’t Gregor’s doing.
这并非格里高尔所为。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Nhh... Aah...
呃……啊……

Yuri’s mouth opens and lets something out.
尤莉张开嘴，痛苦地吐出了什么。

It was a tree branch radiating a bright golden glow.
那是一根散发出明亮金色光芒的树枝。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Seeking the Bough, were you?
你们在找这个枝条吧？

You...
你……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
A bit small, isn’t it?
比你们想的要小。对吧？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I’m Hermann. We’ll be seeing each other often. The reason being...
我是赫尔曼。此后我们会常见面的。因为……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
We... need those Boughs, and you... can find them.
我们……需要那些枝条，而你们……可以找到那些枝条。

dataList.title:

You... won’t die, but we... will kill you.
你们……虽然不会死去，但我们……会杀死你们。

Hermann nudges Yuri’s head with her foot.
赫尔曼用脚轻轻踢开了尤莉的头颅。

dataList.title:

All in due time, of course.
不过，不是现在。

dataList.title:

？？？
dataList.content:
We’ll take good care of the Golden Bough you found.
我们会妥善保管你们找到的金枝。

Gubo... My dear compatriot. Is this the path you have chosen?
仇甫……我亲爱的友人啊。这就是你选择的道路吗？

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Indeed it is. Only few remain now.
没错。已经所剩无几了。

... It’s been a while, Brother.
……好久不见，哥哥。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Do you know how filthy your clothing smells? If only your family were here to see the sorry state you're in.
你知道你的衣服闻起来有多恶心吗？家里人真该看看你现在的样子。

Some reunion this has turned into.
变成某种重聚环节了啊。

dataList.title:

How are you treating that gift of mine, son?
和我送你的礼物相处得如何，儿子？

I didn’t invest in you just to see you in such a mess.
我可不是为了看你落入这种处境才在你身上投入的。

I never asked for this... Not once...
我可从来没有想要过……一次也没……

You should at least finish unwrapping the present.

That little arm isn’t all there is to it.
那种程度的能力，可不是我给你的全部。

Alright now. That’s enough greetings.
好了，见面的寒暄就到此为止吧。

The man called Jia Huan clapped twice.
自称为贾环的男人拍了两次手。

Then, everything went dark.
然后，一切都陷入黑暗。

Like...
就如同从长夜的噩梦之中惊醒……

Waking from a long nightmare to the break of dawn.
黎明正向你致意。

After some time passed...
一段时间后……

And I thought this would be an easy enough mission for you.
我还以为这是个易如反掌的任务呢。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
It really is something, your gall to come crawling back here after losing the Golden Bough right before your eyes.
在眼睁睁地看着金枝被抢走之后，你们居然还有脸就这么抬着头回来。

Have I overestimated you?
是我太高估你们了吗？

Why don’t you give me an excuse, Miss Faust.
浮士德女士，不妨找个借口吧。

As it turns out, immortality wasn’t the solution to everything.
不会死去并不能解决所有问题。

Anything to say for yourself, Dante?
你有什么要为自己辩解的吗，但丁？

<There was another group going after the Golden Bough.>
<还有一个势力在收集金枝。>

<You had to have known this, so why didn’t you warn me?>
<你肯定知道这件事，为什么没有提前警告？>

They’re asking about the other faction that sought the Golden Bough.
其在询问另一个收集金枝的势力信息。

Faust placidly relayed my words to Vergilius.
浮士德平静地把我的话向维吉里乌斯转述了一遍。

... Don’t tell me you're blaming me for this?
……难不成，你这是在追究我的责任？

Tell me then, Dante. Why would we bother sending 12 whole combatants to a place with no threats?
那么告诉我，但丁。我们为什么会把十二名战斗人员派到一个没有任何威胁的地方？

After hiring Fixers to guide them, too.
甚至还雇佣了收尾人来引导他们。

<That’s...>
<那是因为……>

Enough of that, Manager Bud.
算了。经理兄。

It’s my fault. If you want someone to blame, I’m right here...
是我的错。责任就由我来……

How fascinating.
真有趣。

Built a sense of camaraderie between you already.
认识还没有多久，你们之间就建立起了这样的战友情谊。

Well, I do suppose it’s not too bad to cover up for each other since you’re all in the same bus...
好吧，既然你们都在同一辆巴士上，彼此开脱也不是什么坏事……

Just know that sticking up for one another doesn’t make up for your incompetence.
但我希望你们不要有这种错觉，以为互相开脱就能掩盖你们的无能。

... We got a call. After Team’s Spec Ops Section 4 has just gone underground for their job.
……我们接到了联络。收尾部队的第四特别作战部已经进入地下执行作战计划。

That sounds about right. Someone has to salvage the E.G.O and Abnormalities left there.
没错，就该这样。总得有人回收那些遗留的E.G.O和异想体。

... A real shame that the essence was lost, though.
……可真正的精髓已经遗失了。

This is getting excessive.
说得有些太多了吧。

Failure is a common thing on the battlefield. If an objective isn't met, you devise another plan and redeploy.
胜败乃兵家常事。如果没能达成目标，那就再次制定作战方案并再次部署。

Are you sure it wasn’t your expectations that were too high for our first mission? I will have you know that the Executive Manager's performance was nothing short of outstanding.
难道不是你对我们的初次作战抱有过高的期望吗？你难道没看见经理的初次指挥就取得了出人意料的成果吗？

I suppose we’ll leave it at that. You’re not entirely wrong.
我想就到此为止吧。嗯，你说的倒也不是完全没道理。

Certainly.
当然。

There seemed to be an uncanny tension between Vergilius and Faust...
有一种微妙的紧张气氛弥漫在维吉里乌斯与浮士德之间……

But right now, I had neither the energy nor the willpower left in me to get inquisitive.
但现在，我既没有力气也没有精神对此追根究底。

The bus reeked with the metallic stench of blood and gore that clung to our outfits, but no one thought to open the windows.
巴士上满是凝固的血肉腥气，还混合着铁锈味，但没有任何一个人想去打开车窗。

And no one had the urge to have a change of clothes.
也没有人有换下被血浸透的衣服的想法。

All of us just sat in place, dwelling on silence.
我们全都只是坐在位置上，默不作声。

Gregor, who had the most defeated look of them all, stared despondently out the window...
在他们之中，格里高尔更是一脸沉重地凝视着窗外……

Then, he suddenly went to hang something from his pocket near the windshield of the bus.
然后，他突然把什么东西从口袋里取出，挂在了巴士的挡风玻璃边上。

Bug Guy. What did you put on Mephi’s head?
虫男。你在梅菲的头上放了什么？

... A memento.
……遗物。

A memento for two.
两个人的遗物。

I had a sister, just about Yuri’s age.
正好，我曾有个和尤莉小姐差不多大的妹妹。

That’s... all there is.
就是……有这么一回事。

I considered giving him a pep talk, but the idea quickly dissipated.
我考虑过说些什么来鼓舞他一下，但这种想法很快就消失了。

Ishmael wore a grieving look, Sinclair was quietly weeping, and Rodya let out a distressed sigh; if they couldn’t offer him any encouragement, what good would I do?
无论是满脸悲伤的以实玛利，还是低声啜泣的辛克莱，抑或是苦恼叹息着的罗佳，都不愿意再说一句话。

Charon, won’t this get in your way?
卡戎，这不会对你的视野造成妨碍吗？

No, Charon’ll be fine.
嗯，卡戎没关系。

... Alright, let’s hit the road.
……好，出发吧。

Vroom-vroom.
布隆布隆。

The bus slowly grumbled forward.
巴士缓缓地震动着向前行驶。

The gas mask hanging by the windshield gently swayed like an ornament.
挂在挡风玻璃边的防毒面具仿佛某种饰品一样静静地摇摆着。
